places.name: Timpanogos Cave National Monument
places.access_note: Park at the lot near the visitors center.

places.access_note: Starts where SR-92 turns off US-189 in Provo Canyon and comes out in American Fork Canyon. Narrow and winding, and closed in winter.

places.access_note: Up Squaw Peak Road (now Kyhv Peak Road) off Provo Canyon; winding, paved most of the way. Reserve a site ahead.

ideas.title: Sunset walk up Rock Canyon
ideas.description: Walk a mile or two up the canyon as the rock walls catch the last light, then turn around and come down to the city lights. Free, close to town, and quiet enough to actually talk.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (the trailhead). Address is descriptive; add the street if you want.

ideas.title: Walk to Bridal Veil Falls
ideas.description: An easy paved walk to the foot of a 600-foot double waterfall in Provo Canyon. Go in spring when it's roaring, or bundle up in winter when it freezes into ice. Bring a snack and sit by the river after.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (the park). Check the paved trail is open; parts close for repairs some years.

ideas.title: Sunrise hike to the Y
ideas.description: Climb the switchbacks to the giant Y above BYU and watch the sun come up over the valley and Utah Lake. It's short but steep, so start in the dark with headlamps and bring water.
ideas.safety_note: About a mile of steep switchbacks with no shade. Bring water and headlamps, and skip it when the trail is icy.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (the trailhead).

ideas.title: Stewart Falls hike from Aspen Grove
ideas.description: A shady trail through aspens under Mount Timpanogos to a tall two-tier waterfall. About an hour each way at an easy pace, with plenty of spots to stop. In late September the whole mountain turns gold.
ideas.notes: Pin is Aspen Grove from OpenStreetMap, not the exact lot. Price assumes a canyon day-use fee split two ways: check the current fee.

ideas.title: Battle Creek Falls Hike
ideas.description: A short, steady climb from a neighborhood park in Pleasant Grove to a waterfall you can walk right up to. Done in under two hours.
ideas.notes: Pin and address are Kiwanis Park in Pleasant Grove (OpenStreetMap has it open dawn to dusk).

ideas.title: Tour Timpanogos Cave
ideas.description: Hike the steep paved trail up the side of American Fork Canyon, then follow a ranger through three connected caves full of helictites and crystal formations. It's cool inside even in July. Tickets sell out, so book a tour time first.
ideas.safety_note: The trail climbs about 1,000 feet in 1.5 miles with drop-offs. Tickets are required; book ahead.
ideas.notes: Price is a guess (tour ticket plus canyon fee): check current prices. Season dates vary by year.

ideas.title: Cascade Springs boardwalk
ideas.description: Drive the Alpine Loop to a hidden spot where springs bubble up and spill down a hillside in little terraced pools. Boardwalks and short paths wind through it. Go late in the day for golden light and a pretty drive home.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (the springs). The Alpine Loop closes in winter. Price assumes a canyon fee split two ways.

ideas.title: Fall colors on the Alpine Loop
ideas.description: Take the winding mountain road from Provo Canyon over to American Fork Canyon when the aspens and maples turn gold and red. Roll the windows down, pull over at every overlook you like, and take it slow: the views are what it’s all about.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap: where SR-92 leaves US-189 (Nov 2026). Was pinned to Sundance with a hot chocolate stop; that's its own idea now (provo/sundance-hot-chocolate). Price: check the American Fork Canyon fee.

ideas.title: Mountain dinner at Sundance
ideas.description: Dress up a little and drive into Provo Canyon for dinner at Sundance Resort, tucked under Mount Timpanogos. Get there before sunset so you can walk the grounds first, then eat by the window.
ideas.notes: Check which restaurants are open and book a table. Price is a guess per person.

ideas.title: Hot chocolate at Sundance
ideas.description: Get something warm to drink at Sundance Resort and wander the grounds under Mount Timpanogos: the wooden buildings, the creek, and the little shops. Cozy when the leaves turn, and even better in the snow.
ideas.notes: Split from the Alpine Loop idea (one activity, one place). Check where on the grounds sells hot drinks, and their hours.

ideas.title: Sunset on Utah Lake
ideas.description: Walk out along the marina breakwater at Utah Lake State Park and watch the sun drop behind the western mountains. The sky reflects off the water for a long time after. Bring a blanket and something warm to drink.
ideas.notes: Price assumes the state park day-use fee split two ways: check it. Address is from OpenStreetMap (the campground).

ideas.title: Bike the Provo River Parkway
ideas.description: Ride the paved trail along the Provo River from Riverwoods toward the canyon, past cottonwoods and little bridges. Go as far as you like, then turn around and coast back.
ideas.notes: Bring your own bikes (or walk it). Pin from OpenStreetMap (the parkway near Riverwoods).

ideas.title: Riverside picnic at Vivian Park
ideas.description: Pack sandwiches and lemonade and find a shady spot by the Provo River in the canyon. Watch the water, skip rocks, and maybe catch the old Heber train rolling past.
ideas.notes: Check the train line still runs past (Heber Valley Railroad); drop that line if not.

ideas.title: Saturday morning at the farmers market
ideas.description: Wander the Provo Farmers Market at Pioneer Park with a pastry in hand. Taste samples, pick out fruit for the week, listen to whoever's playing, and grab something new to cook together that night.
ideas.notes: Hours from OpenStreetMap (Saturdays 9-2). Check the season dates for this year.

ideas.title: Ice skating at the Peaks Arena
ideas.description: Skate where the 2002 Olympic hockey games were played. Hold hands, laugh when someone wobbles, and see who can skate backwards by the end. Public skating times change, so check before you go.
ideas.notes: Price is a guess (admission plus skate rental): check current prices and public skate times.

ideas.title: Wander the BYU Museum of Art
ideas.description: Free, quiet, and usually not crowded. Each of you picks a favorite piece in every gallery and explains why, then see how often you agreed.
ideas.notes: Closed Sundays. Pin from OpenStreetMap; hours not listed there, so add them.

ideas.title: Ice cream at the BYU Creamery
ideas.description: A Provo classic: huge scoops of ice cream made on campus, for not much money. Order a flavor you'd never pick for yourself and trade halfway through.
ideas.notes: OpenStreetMap's hours use month ranges the app can't read, so hours are unknown here. Closed Sundays. Address to confirm.

ideas.title: Adventurous ice cream at Rockwell
ideas.description: Each pick the strangest flavor in the case at Rockwell on University Avenue, try a bite of each other's, and vote on who chose better. A sweet, easy end to a night downtown.
ideas.notes: Hours from OpenStreetMap: check they're current.

ideas.title: Custom dirty sodas at Sodalicious
ideas.description: Each order a custom soda you've never tried, swap halfway, and decide whose mix wins. Utah's most Utah date, and it fits into any free half hour.
ideas.notes: Hours from OpenStreetMap. A chain: per the place policy this may be better as a stop than a featured idea.

ideas.title: Fry bread at Black Sheep Cafe
ideas.description: Native American and Southwestern food in downtown Provo: posole, Navajo tacos on fry bread, and green chile. Share a few plates so you both get to try everything.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap. Confirm it's open and add hours. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Farm-to-table dinner at Communal
ideas.description: A dressed-up night out in downtown Provo, with seasonal dishes made from local ingredients. Order a few things to share and save room for dessert.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap. Confirm it's still open, the menu style, and reservations. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Curry night at Bombay House
ideas.description: A long-time Provo favorite for Indian food. Order something milder and something spicier, plus a pile of garlic naan, and split everything down the middle.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap. Add the street address and hours. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Comfort food at Station 22
ideas.description: Southern-style comfort food on Center Street, like fried chicken and mac and cheese. Casual, filling, and right in the middle of downtown, so you can walk it off after.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap. Add hours. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Pizza at Brick Oven
ideas.description: Provo has been doing first dates at Brick Oven for decades. Get a pizza to share and the root beer, and ask each other the questions you never got around to asking.
ideas.notes: Address, pin and hours from OpenStreetMap. Check the root beer line is still true.

ideas.title: French toast breakfast at Kneaders
ideas.description: Start a Saturday slowly with the all-you-can-eat French toast and a hot drink, and linger over plans for the day.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap. A chain (see the place policy). Check the French toast deal and hours.

ideas.title: A show at Velour
ideas.description: Catch a local band at Velour, the small downtown venue that launched a lot of Provo's indie acts. Look up who's playing and get there early for a good spot.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap. Ticket prices vary by show (this is a guess). Add the website for the calendar.

ideas.title: A show at the Covey Center
ideas.description: See a play, a concert, or a comedy night at Provo's downtown performing arts center. Check the calendar, pick something neither of you would usually choose, and talk it over on the way home.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap. Ticket prices vary (this is a guess). Add the website.

ideas.title: Musical at Hale Center Theater
ideas.description: An intimate theater in Orem with Broadway-style musicals and plays, where every seat is close to the stage. Dress up a little and compare favorite songs at intermission.
ideas.notes: Address and pin from OpenStreetMap, which may be outdated: confirm this is the right Hale theater and that it's still running shows here. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Bowling and arcade at Fat Cats
ideas.description: Bowl a couple of games with a silly bet on the line (loser picks the next date), then spend your tickets in the arcade. Loud, easy, and good for a group too.
ideas.notes: Address, pin and hours from OpenStreetMap. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: BYU football game
ideas.description: Wear blue, get there early to soak in the tailgate crowd, and cheer from the stands with the mountains behind the field. Bring a blanket for November games.
ideas.notes: Ticket prices vary a lot by game (this is a guess). Only on game days: consider a holiday-style window later.

ideas.title: Stroll Ashton Gardens
ideas.description: Wander 50 acres of themed gardens at Thanksgiving Point in Lehi, with waterfalls, a big lawn, and a famous spring tulip festival. Find a bench, people-watch, and pick the garden you'd plant at home.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap. Price is a guess: check admission. About 20 minutes north of Provo.

ideas.title: Sauna and cold plunge at PLUNJ
ideas.description: Take turns between a hot sauna and an ice-cold plunge, the contrast-therapy craze that's all over Utah right now. Dare each other to stay in the cold a little longer, then leave feeling buzzing and relaxed at once.
ideas.safety_note: Skip the cold plunge with a heart condition or if you're pregnant, and ease in slowly.
ideas.notes: Address from listings online; pin from OpenStreetMap's address search. Price is a guess: check session prices and book ahead.

ideas.title: Make your own soap at The Soap Factory
ideas.description: Pick colors, scents and molds and make soap for each other on Center Street, across from the Provo City Center Temple. Paint the bars once they set, then trade: you each go home smelling like the other's choices.
ideas.notes: Not in OpenStreetMap yet: pin from its address. Hours and pricing come from travel and review sites and may be old (studio fee plus cents per gram): check before going. Groups of 8+ should call ahead.

ideas.title: Hammocks by the river in Provo Canyon
ideas.description: Bring two hammocks (or one big one) and hang them between the cottonwoods by the Provo River at Nunn's Park. Read, nap, listen to the water, and walk a stretch of the parkway when you're ready to move.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Use wide tree straps (they protect the bark); check the park allows hammocks.

ideas.title: Campfire and s'mores up the canyon
ideas.description: Reserve a site at Hope Campground above Provo Canyon, build a fire as the sun goes down, roast hot dogs and s'mores, and stay out until the stars come out. A whole evening of nothing but talking by the fire.
ideas.safety_note: Check fire restrictions first (summer bans are common), use the fire ring, and drown the fire completely before you leave.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Price is a guess (site fee and food split two ways). OpenStreetMap has it open May to September.

ideas.title: Unlimited French toast at Magleby's
ideas.description: A favorite Provo brunch: all-you-can-eat French toast with the toppings piled high. Go hungry on a slow weekend morning and see who can keep up.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Add the street number and hours. Check the unlimited French toast is still on the menu and which days. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Pick a book for each other at Pioneer Book
ideas.description: Get lost in the stacks of a big used bookstore on Center Street. Set a five-dollar budget, pick a book you think the other person would love, and swap them at the register.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Hours from OpenStreetMap.

ideas.title: Dig through records at 3hive
ideas.description: Flip through vinyl at a little record lounge on Center Street, listen to a few, and each pick a record that says something about you.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Hours from OpenStreetMap (Wednesday to Saturday). Price assumes buying one record.

ideas.title: A Dry Bar Comedy taping
ideas.description: Be in the audience for clean stand-up comedy being filmed for Dry Bar on Center Street. It's a small room, so every seat is close, and you might even spot yourselves laughing online later.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Check how tickets work now and the show schedule. Price is a guess.

ideas.title: Liquid-nitrogen ice cream at Sub Zero
ideas.description: Build your own ice cream and watch it freeze in front of you in a cloud of liquid nitrogen. Each make one for the other person, then trade and judge.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). OpenStreetMap's hours weren't readable: add them. A chain that started in Utah.

ideas.title: Axe throwing at Rhyno's
ideas.description: Learn to throw axes at a wooden target with a coach showing you how, then keep score in a friendly match. Surprisingly easy to pick up, very satisfying when it sticks, and good for a group date too.
ideas.safety_note: Follow the coach's rules and wear closed-toe shoes.
ideas.notes: Pin from OpenStreetMap (Nov 2026). Hours from OpenStreetMap. Price is a guess. In Orem.
